correctness.rationale: The exact four-facet ray formula reduces by signed-permutation symmetry to 48 spherical chambers. Within a chamber the chord length is 2A√(1+q²)/(A²−q²), increasing in q; a factored polynomial proves the global endpoints. Exact inversion and area integration provide the full CDF. At 12 minima the normalized Hessian has determinant one, giving \(3\varepsilon\); at 8 maxima the piecewise-linear deficit has triangular area \(\sqrt3\,\varepsilon^2/8\), giving \(\sqrt3\,\varepsilon^2/(4\pi)\). Tight local expansions and dominated density convergence establish the stated conditional uniform limits. The checked program confirms but is not used as a substitute for infinite proof.

value.rationale: The centroidal line distribution is a natural directional geometric invariant, distinct from Crofton translation-averaged chord statistics. It gives a complete computable distribution for a fundamental non-centrally-symmetric Platonic body and explains two different extreme-direction scaling geometries (quadratic ellipse versus linear triangle), with exact leading constants and total-variation configuration laws.
